title: Important Update: CBIC Advisory on ACES-GST Portal Maintenance on October 24, 2026
content:
# Important Update: CBIC Advisory on ACES-GST Portal Maintenance on October 24, 2026

Ek important update hai for all Central Excise, Service Tax, HSNS, SBS, and SVLDRS taxpayers. The Directorate General of Systems, CBIC ne ACES-GST portal par planned maintenance activity announce ki hai.

Here are the key details:

*   **What:** Scheduled maintenance activity on the ACES-GST portal (https://cbic-gst.gov.in).
*   **When:** The maintenance will take place on **October 24, 2026**, from **21:30 hours to 22:30 hours**.
*   **Impact:** During this one-hour window, the ACES-GST portal and its services related to Central Excise, Service Tax, HSNS, SBS, and SVLDRS will be unavailable.
*   **Advisory:** Taxpayers are advised to plan their activities accordingly to avoid any inconvenience.

Please make sure to complete any urgent transactions outside this scheduled downtime. Your cooperation is appreciated.

*   [Visit the Official CBIC-GST Portal for Latest Updates](https://cbic-gst.gov.in)

*Published on: 24 October 2026*
